examples.scenario: Reference raster and candidate have same extrema but different pixels.
examples.reason: Golden comparison must include pixel content, not only min/max.

examples.scenario: Candidate matches pixels but CRS metadata changed.
examples.reason: Terminal evidence requires CRS equivalence as well as values.

examples.scenario: Candidate matches values but geotransform differs by half a pixel.
examples.reason: Identical values at shifted locations are not equivalent evidence.

examples.scenario: Binary bytes differ although semantic raster comparison passes.
examples.reason: Storage-level drift must be recorded even when semantic content is equal.

examples.scenario: A pipeline materializes an intermediate and later treats it as original source.
examples.reason: Materialized pipeline datasets are derived artifacts.

examples.scenario: Temporary materialized GeoTIFF uses different creation options in replay.
examples.reason: Intermediate representation must be reproducible.

examples.scenario: clean-collar modifies edge pixels before elevation extrema.
examples.reason: Collar cleaning is a mutating preprocessing operation.

examples.scenario: clean-collar adds a mask that excludes native cells.
examples.reason: A generated mask cannot silently replace native validity.

examples.scenario: Raster index points to a different tile path with same footprint.
examples.reason: Tile identity requires filename/resource lineage, not footprint alone.

examples.scenario: Raster edit overrides CRS without reprojecting pixels.
examples.reason: Metadata edits can make unchanged pixels appear in a different coordinate system.

examples.scenario: Raster edit writes approximate statistics and they are used as exact extrema.
examples.reason: Stored/approximate statistics are not terminal exact scans.

examples.scenario: nodata-to-alpha changes invalid-pixel logic.
examples.reason: Nodata and alpha semantics must be reconciled explicitly.

examples.scenario: Band selection reorders elevation and quality bands.
examples.reason: Elevation band identity must be pinned.

examples.scenario: Mask band is selected as a normal data band.
examples.reason: Mask identity cannot be conflated with numeric elevation.

examples.scenario: Stack input order changes between runs.
examples.reason: Band/source order is part of lineage.

examples.scenario: Raster is retiled and derived tiles are called native cells.
examples.reason: Retiling creates a derived representation.

examples.scenario: Raster scale auto-computes a range and clips source values.
examples.reason: Scaling can change numeric extrema.

examples.scenario: Remote COG validation skips full byte checks under auto mode.
examples.reason: Remote and local validation depth must be explicit.

examples.scenario: Pixel as-features row/col matches but center X/Y does not.
examples.reason: Independent row/col and center-coordinate lineage must agree.

examples.scenario: Raster update writes values into canonical target file.
examples.reason: Canonical input bytes must remain immutable.

examples.scenario: Raster update refreshes overviews after modifying full resolution.
examples.reason: Overview changes cannot hide source mutation.

examples.scenario: /vsicurl cache contains old chunks after remote asset changed.
examples.reason: Remote byte identity requires cache policy plus digest/readback.

examples.scenario: GDAL configuration changes threading or open options between runs.
examples.reason: Configuration is part of deterministic execution provenance.

examples.scenario: Template-created raster matches dimensions/CRS but has no source pixels.
examples.reason: Structural similarity is not pixel identity.

examples.scenario: Overview is added with average resampling and then sampled as native.
examples.reason: Downsampled overview values are derived.

examples.scenario: VSI sync copy has same filename but no post-copy digest.
examples.reason: Copied bytes must be digest-verified.

examples.scenario: Golden compare passes after optional checks are skipped.
examples.reason: Terminal comparison must not skip CRS/geotransform/overview/metadata/pixel checks.

examples.scenario: Numeric height difference is published before canonical point and immutable raster replay exist.
examples.reason: Real numeric output remains fail-closed until canonical execution evidence exists.
